Free-cash-flow margin of 6.4% and a net-cash balance sheet (net debt/EBITDA -0.89x) support the diversion-and-surcharge role from a clean base.

risks.claim: Revenue fell 18.5% CAGR over three years off a 2022 pandemic-era freight-rate peak (258953171000.0 TWD in 2022 to 140353465000.0 TWD in 2025), so the reverse-DCF's 18.3% implied FCF CAGR is priced against a base still normalizing down from that peak.
The reverse-DCF solve carries a 7.22-point horizon spread (18.3% at 5 years versus 11.1% at 10 years), so the headline implied-growth figure is sensitive to which explicit period a dive assumes.
